items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: No, but I heard something about her name like that. George Foster.

ctx.x: In the city? Mm-hmm. Well, I tell you, I got disgusted out there. And just make up my mind. Well, most of all my people... Yeah, family problems. And then I had... Well, I just had the family trouble too. But most of all my people was in town. Sister, mother, and everybody. Brother. So I just make up my mind to come. And then I had a bad family trouble too, just like she said.
You know George Foster out there in the country? He's from up around Macau, further up the river.
No, but I heard something about her name like that. George Foster.
